name: partner_research
instructions: Evaluate potential implementation partner fit by answering the 6-question gatekeeper checklist, identify the verified partner practice, and cite verbatim evidence from the multi-source dossier. The pipeline computes the completeness score and tier.

checklist.description: Evidence-bound checklist: answer every item true or false; each true item must be supported by a cited quote. The pipeline computes the score.

q1_target_stack.description: True only when source evidence verifies active delivery capability in the target or adjacent tech stack.

q2_service_model.description: True only when source evidence confirms turnkey systems integration, migration, or architecture practice (false for pure SaaS vendors or hourly staff aug).

q3_industry_verticals.description: True only when source evidence confirms client delivery experience in specific industry verticals.

q4_geography_delivery.description: True only when source evidence confirms physical headquarters and engineering delivery locations.

q5_vendor_alliances.description: True only when source evidence confirms certified partner tiers with adjacent vendors (e.g. AWS Premier, Snowflake Elite).

q6_case_study_proof.description: True only when source evidence verifies a concrete project outcome, transformation metric, or client case study.

score.description: Computed by the pipeline from the checklist; omit it. Partner fit: 85-100 all 6 questions answered with multi-source proof (Tier 1), 70-84 at least 5 questions answered (Tier 2), 50-69 partial fit (Tier 3), 0-49 missing key criteria, staff-aug only, or SaaS vendor.

identified_practice.description: The verified partner practice, capability, or core service offering, named exactly as the source names it.

answers.description: Structured answers to the gatekeeper questions, supported by cited quotes.

target_stack.description: Verified technologies and platforms implemented for clients.

industry_verticals.description: Client industry verticals with verified delivery proof.

vendor_alliances.description: Certified partner tiers and technology vendor badges.

case_study_outcome.description: Specific project outcome or transformation metric achieved for a client.

source_diversity_count.description: Number of distinct source categories (First-Party, Vendor Registry, Review Audit, Community, ATS) cited in the supporting quotes.

fit_tier.description: Score band, derived by the pipeline: tier_1 85-100, tier_2 70-84, tier_3 50-69, unfit below 50. Omit it.

reasoning.description: Short explanation grounded in the cited quotes, naming the multi-source evidence behind the checklist and answers.
